title: Creamy Tomato Soup
description: A pantry tomato soup with a swirl of cream and plenty of black pepper.
imageAlt: Painted bowl of tomato soup with a swirl of cream and toast
ingredients: Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until soft, about 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Turn off the heat and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in the cream and season with salt and black pepper. Serve with buttery toast.
